==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
{{Checklist|Bring all required items for the quest with you.
*Talk to [[King Arthur]]. {{Chat option|1|1I want to become a knight of the round table!}}
*Talk to [[Sir Gawain]], who can be found in the courtyard to the south or nearby in the castle. {{Chat option|3Do you know how Merlin got trapped?}}
*Talk to [[Sir Lancelot]] upstairs. {{Chat option|3Any ideas on how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?}}
*Go to [[Catherby]].
**If you didn't bring a bucket of wax, grab [[insect repellent]] in the house north of the bank in Catherby.
**Use the insect repellent on one of the beehives to the west with an empty bucket (a bucket can be found near the beehives) in your inventory to get a bucket of wax.
*Hide in the crate east of the [[candle maker]]'s shop. {{Chat option|1Yes}} Wait and finish the cutscene. Climb out of the crate. {{Chat option|1Yes}}
}}

===Inside the keep===
{{Checklist|
*Climb to the top floor. The [[Renegade Knight]]s will attack you on your way up.
*Attack [[Sir Mordred]]. He cannot be safespotted, but he can be flinched using the stairs (position him on the square left of the stairs whilst flinching from the square north-east of him). He can also be killed with [[rings of recoil]]s or by another account poisoning and attacking right before his death.
*When Sir Mordred reaches 0 hitpoints, Morgan Le Faye will appear and ask that you spare him. Spare his life to discover how to save Merlin. {{Chat option|1Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might.|2OK I will do all that.}} {{Colour|red|Warning:}} Do '''not''' interrupt the dialogue or you will have to fight Sir Mordred again.
**If you don't already have bat bones, exit the keep through the west doors and kill a bat before leaving.
**Can be recoiled down after dealing a 0 and not splashing Magic.}}

===Black candle===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to the candle-maker in Catherby. {{Chat option|1Have you got any black candles?}}
*Talk to him again for a black candle.
}}

===Excalibur===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[The Lady of the Lake]] south-east of [[Taverley]] on the peninsula. {{Chat option|3I seek the sword Excalibur.}}
*Go to [[Port Sarim]]. (Make sure you have bread in your inventory.)
*Enter the jewellery shop to the north.
*Give the beggar your bread. {{Chat option|1Yes certainly.}} Finish the conversation. 
}}

===Ritual===
{{Checklist|
*Go to the Zamorakian temple in the south-east corner of Varrock. 
*Check the Chaos Altar's inscription.
*Return to Camelot with a tinderbox and enter the castle gates.
*Go to the ritual site at the north-east corner of the Camelot castle grounds (a red star in the middle of 8 columns).
*Stand on the star and light the black candle.
*'''Drop''' the bat bones on the star.
*The magic words are "Snarthon Candtrick Termanto".
}}

===Finishing up===
{{Checklist|
*Enter the castle and climb to the top of the south-east tower.
*Smash the giant crystal with Excalibur. ('''Does not''' require 20 Attack, just use Excalibur on the crystal instead of attempting to wield it)
*Talk to King Arthur.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
